name: Gip
source:
Gip is the Uncle of the Protagonist on the Protagonist's father's side. Gip serves as the main antagonist of the game and also owns the local bunny bar.
 Gip is a very shameless and perverted indiviual that is willing to take advantage of others.
 Gip wears a red Hawaiian shirt with flowers, blue shorts and sunglasses. Gip is visible overweight and old with gray hair and a hairy mole on his left cheek.
